story: Old window panes are thicker at the bottom because glass is a slow liquid and gravity has pulled it down over the centuries.
told_where: physics textbooks, museum guides, this session (Zach, 2026-09-27)
observation: Many old panes really are thicker at the bottom.
mechanism_claimed: Room-temperature glass flows under gravity on a scale of centuries.
test_that_decided: Zanotto, Am. J. Phys. 1998: relaxation time from measured viscosity ~1e32 years; panes thicker at the top and sides exist; crown-glass process documented to make uneven sheets.
teaches: A real observation plus a plausible mechanism can carry a false binding for a century; the falsifying calculation cost one afternoon nobody spent. Apparent drift may be a birth defect.

story: An external audit crawled the repo and mapped ARCS Operators 1 through 19 to specific files at 'Full Production' status.
observation: The named files exist and the operator names are in the canon.
mechanism_claimed: Each numbered operator is implemented by the file listed.
test_that_decided: grep sweep: 0 hits for shavasana/hyperstition/accountant/sycophancy; five named files implement something else; the 1-19 numbering was the document's own (periodic table has Folksonomy=20, Librarian=21).
teaches: Real files, plausible mapping, wrong binding: the exact shape the integrity gate exists for. A hand-written map lies silently; a generated one that greps cannot.

story: In the vacuum of space there is no hot; heat instantly diffuses away.
told_where: this session (Zach, offered as a premise, 2026-09-27); common belief
observation: Space is cold; objects in shadow get very cold.
mechanism_claimed: Absence of a medium makes heat leave instantly.
test_that_decided: A vacuum blocks conduction and convection; the only loss channel is radiation, which is slow. A thermos works by vacuum. Spacecraft struggle to dump heat.
teaches: The corrected mechanism was the better lesson: the vacuum is where nothing can be handed off, and the only loss is slow, invisible, toward the background.

story: A clean room needs a vacuum.
observation: Clean rooms have sealed doors and airlocks.
mechanism_claimed: Cleanliness comes from removing the air.
test_that_decided: Clean rooms run at positive pressure with continuous HEPA-filtered laminar flow; negative pressure is for containment labs.
teaches: Clean because nothing stays, not because nothing enters. ARCS is the second kind: the corpus is supposed to breathe.

story: Operator 20 (the folksonomy cultivator) has an import bug and is starved of real receipts; it is gated vaporware.
observation: An import error was observed when op20 was invoked.
test_that_decided: Full-fidelity op20 run over 247 real prod receipts via a faithful adapter: 17 archetypes at silhouette 0.765. The error was a harness error; the missing piece was a field adapter.
teaches: The observed error was real; the diagnosis was not. Test the operator, not the story about it.

story: Hermes never did any arcs-v9 work; its sessions table shows zero.
observation: The state.db sessions table has no arcs-v9 rows.
mechanism_claimed: Absence in the table means absence of work.
test_that_decided: session_search (FTS) surfaced real repo-committing Hermes sessions from 2026-09-11, including the handoff push at 6c19ec6f.
teaches: A SQL-table absence is not proof of absence; the index you queried may not be the one that records the thing.

story: An end user, mid-call, said he was 'smelling arcs' while reaching for a word for how the conversation felt.
observation: Verbatim line in the saved transcript, disfluencies preserved.
mechanism_claimed: ARCS is perceptible from the outside as a sensation before it is a feature.
test_that_decided: Verbatim transcript on file; fact-checked 2026-08-23 against the source (attribution corrected).
teaches: The first recorded instance of the product being felt rather than described. Lore of the pre-witness era, recovered by generative recoil.

story: Trust is an outcome of a successful earned opinion.
observation: A one-line text, verbatim from screenshot.
mechanism_claimed: Trust is not requested or asserted; it is the residue of opinions that were earned.
teaches: Mood board for the source-trust ledger built 2026-09-27: tiers are derived from the record, never claimed. The text-register proverb became a generated table five weeks later.

story: A flash of brilliance mid-conversation needs a scribe: 'can I get a witness' that the tree did fall and this is the sound it made.
told_where: Zach, session night-moves-work-digest, 2026-08-11 (transcript, turn found by the backfill scout)
observation: The verbatim request exists in the transcript.
mechanism_claimed: Naming moments evaporate unless attested at the moment, not at handoff.
test_that_decided: The witness register exists: 16 daily files since 2026-08-11, the /witness skill, the backfill scout (141 candidates) built 2026-09-27.
teaches: Lore that became mechanism: the request was itself the first witness-shaped moment, and the scout found it.

story: The Claude Code harness loads only the first ~24KB of the memory index and silently drops the rest.
observation: An 80KB index produced a session that saw only the top sections.
mechanism_claimed: A fixed read cap applied at a line boundary.
test_that_decided: Spawned session stoic-chandrasekhar-96414f: 144 of 382 lines injected, 25,284 bytes / 24,907 chars, warning appended. Cap sits in [24,907, 25,159] chars.
teaches: Measure the constant instead of repeating it. The earlier '~24.4KB' note was the same number, unverified until a session was spent on it.

story: ARCS should hold an Olympics: primitives, operators, ordinals and invariants compete under load, and the ones with unknown use cases are exalted. The torch is the flame's chain of custody, lit from one source, never from a lighter.
observation: The graduation gate (RC-OPS-001) exists with four criteria and no ceremony.
mechanism_claimed: A ceremony around the gate would make graduation legible and exalt cross-domain wins first.
teaches: Mood board for the graduation ceremony: gauntlets as events, Loki and the Detective as judges, provenance as the drug test, write-lock as the truce. Kept as aspiration until a first games is held.

story: A song called Ephemeral Beauty, written the same day the membrane started breathing differently, embodies the mono no aware moment ARCS keeps circling: holding what fades.
told_where: Zach, iCloud, 2026-09-27; lyrics embedded in the file (not reproduced here)
observation: 3:00, verse/chorus/verse/chorus/outro; the outro thins and quiets at 162s; the verb for letting appears five times.
mechanism_claimed: Ephemeral RAM as a nod to mono no aware can spark a real ROM candidate (the 2026-08-01 line the scout surfaced).
teaches: Mood board for the ephemeral-to-durable etch: the song releases rather than resolves, which is what the witness register does to a moment.
